prompt: In the style of wrestling performed by former Greek wrestler Mikhail Theodoropoulos, who won the inaugural olympic medal?
answer: Mikhail (Michail) Theodoropoulos competed in **Greco-Roman wrestling**. The inaugural Olympic wrestling medal in that style—gold at the 1896 Athens Games—was won by **Carl Schuhmann of Germany**.
